content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts exhibit significant mean-reversion bias, failing to capture sustained price spikes above 75 EUR.", "Sentiment scores above 0.67 consistently correlate with actual price increases that the model underestimates.", "The model displays a lag in reacting to sharp downward trends, maintaining elevated forecasts during price crashes.", "Extreme sentiment values (1.00) often precede price overshoots that the linear forecast fails to predict.", "Forecast accuracy degrades rapidly after 10 days as the model ignores volatility clustering in true outcomes.", "Negative sentiment (-0.50 or lower) triggers price drops that the model predicts as flat or slightly rising.", "The model systematically overestimates prices during bearish phases and underestimates during bullish rallies.", "Recent history momentum is not adequately weighted, causing the model to miss immediate trend reversals."]}
